answer: Each identity anchors one metered tundra turbine on its own terrace pad, locking 80 bond plus 25 meter fee, 105 per identity. Each epoch it posts a zephyr output curve; the pad anemometer must match it within 2 percent, and any auditor can recompute both series from the public logs, burning the bond on mismatch. The kth fake needs its own lease at 60 per epoch, so 1,000 fakes pay 165,000, no bulk discount. An honest operator pays 165 once and recovers the 80 bond after a clean epoch. A rented-meter ring fails: one serial cannot yield two pads' distinct gust curves, so both bonds burn.
